title: rosa canina var. glaucophylla
intro: Rosa canina var. glaucophylla, commonly known as the Glaucous-leaved Dog Rose, is a variation of the Rosa canina species, characterized by its greyish leaves. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. glaucophylla include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, among other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
